answer: Mechanism: Continuous Attention Quota (CAQ). Each identity receives a time-sliced stream of unpredictable micro-probes tied to live contexts (opal inventory, meadow sensor drift, ridge routing). Write access scales with an EWMA of timely correct responses; missed/late probes decay quota. Sybils must supply independent parallel attention—operators or compute—per identity, so the attacker’s opportunity cost tracks sustained serial attention and throughput caps at genuine attention capacity.
